purpose: Diagnose fixed archived states only; no model or admission changes
prior_exposure: All earlier development and final-guard outcomes are known. This is subsequent development, not a new blind evaluation.

design.active: Use every declared slot unless its saved state is already breached; no replacement or outcome-based selection.
design.fan: Use each exact original training ID list, target, finite eta or risk-first, H30/L.4/cost.0025, inherited CPI/peak/MDD. Two current actions then branch-own annual-until-breach then hold B.
design.deletions: For each active slot delete each one whole original fan member at fixed state/target/eta/beta; recompute N-1 mean and risk denominator. No refit or recursive replay. Separate self deletion at full training from all-member deletion.
design.continuation: Compare saved adaptive continuation to current actually chosen action followed by B on identical actual market suffix and inherited state. Both start with the same action. Report log-growth, event, MDD and fee differences. Unchosen action adaptive continuation is unavailable.
design.identities: Verify recomputed fullfan Q and current action agree saved trace. Terminal-year continuation is a zero-difference control because no further decision remains.
design.summaries: Report full training separately from OOF; show newly admitted vs rejected archival groups, all slot/active/pending and unique scenario denominators. Do not pool repeats as independent observations.

limitations: Fixed previously declared witness states are not representative sampling or probability calibration.
OOF excludes each realized market ID from its own fan; full120 includes one uniform self member, not an oracle selecting that suffix.
A single realized suffix per state cannot estimate conditional mean or risk; signed residuals are descriptive.
Continuation gaps are neither causal estimates nor Q^pi action advantages or implementable oracle regret.
No alpha, eta, beta, target, admissions or report changes are authorized by the diagnostic; currentC remainsReview.
No branch or deletion result is used to change an executed or future model action.
The fixed witness marketIDs1/2/3/5/6/7/9/13 exclude ledger-specific failureIDs35/52/98/112. This diagnostic cannot identify the causes of those admission-event differences.
